details:
With this latest update holding the back button inside a nested menu moves you from the current menu back to the root of the radial menu. 

Unfortunately, when quickly scanning through the radial menu I have (unknowingly) trained myself to hold down the back button with the expectation that I will either find what I am looking for in the menu and pivot to it, or not find it and immediately go back. This means I am constantly holding the back button with the intention of staying on the current radial menu page and instead being sent back to root accidentally. 

While this is certainly a spacebar heater brain muscle memory thing that will fade with time, I figured I would make a canny to see if enough people might have this same quirk to warrant a toggle/launch option to disable this "hold back to go back to root" behavior. 

(This will also generally slow down menu navigation for me as there is no "safe" place to have your stick sit engaged as any setting could potentially become hold to press in the future and any setting with hold to press in a particular direction becomes a point of frustration when navigating into that menu with muscle memory)
title: Radial Menu back button hold behavior toggle/launch option.
